                # hold the previous one); an empty value is left out so data-service uses its environment (P3)
                creds = {"api_key": _env_file_value("ICICI_API_KEY"), "api_secret": _env_file_value("ICICI_API_SECRET"),
                         "session_token": _env_file_value("ICICI_SESSION_TOKEN")}
                r = await client.post(f"{DATA_SVC}/provider/configure", json={k: v for k, v in creds.items() if v})
F4-API.why: P3 (send the .env token in the reconnect body instead of {}): data-service's /provider/configure fills missing fields from its own environment, which keeps the old token when the login fell back to .env or ui-api's push failed. The script now also sends the token directly on its fallback; this makes _ensure_live_prices correct on every path. _env_file_value is defined later in the same module (dotenv_values of _ROOT/.env, a small sync read).
